title: Building your personal AI toolkit and learning roadmap
body:
To keep growing past this course, a few ongoing habits matter:

  • Pick a primary tool you use regularly enough to build real fluency, rather than constantly switching.
  • Keep growing your prompt library — every genuinely useful prompt you write is worth saving.
  • Practice on real tasks, not hypothetical ones — the skill sharpens fastest when the output actually matters to you.
  • Stay current deliberately — this field moves fast; periodically check in on new model releases and techniques.
  • Review your own failures — when a prompt doesn't work, diagnose why (vague? wrong format? missing context?) rather than just trying again randomly.
💡 The single best way to keep improving is consistent, real-world use — treat every interaction with an AI tool as a small chance to notice what worked and what didn't.
